title: Batista breaks away from Evolution
summary: Batista discovers Triple H’s manipulation and chooses to challenge his mentor. Three major title matches establish him outside Evolution’s hierarchy.

chapters.title: Batista sees through Triple H
chapters.result: Batista learns of Triple H’s scheme and chooses his WrestleMania opponent.
chapters.context: The Royal Rumble winner breaks with Evolution’s leader.

chapters.title: The pupil takes the championship
chapters.result: Batista defeats Triple H for the World Heavyweight Championship.

chapters.title: Batista wins inside Hell in a Cell
chapters.context: The Cell match provides the decisive title-defense milestone in this arc.
